scope: Actual Meta requests in isolated software experiments with real pinned evidence. No physical Mars equipment operation or engineering qualification claimed.

water_assurance.reason: Hold water: local ice yield unmeasured - soil_ice_fraction uninstrumented, SWIM 3km consistency only, SHARAD site null, basis is design allocation; Rodwell start-up unvalidated, mass/cost unestimated; plus open no-site-imagery. Release rodwell-1, escalate to director.

open_conditions.text: No orbital hazard imagery of the mission site has been analysed

director.summary: Both resources and assurance agree to HOLD water; no disagreement. Power and drill are complete, but soil_ice_fraction is uninstrumented, SWIM 0.389 is 3-km regional consistency not yield, SHARAD site value is null, and Rodwell start-up, kWh/kg, mass and cost remain unvalidated/unestimated; the 15,701 kg basis is a design allocation only. Water stays blocked last. No water batch (would duplicate water and exceed storage/feed) or unsupported survey extension. Excavators at 571.9 Wh exceed the 131.9 Wh step; existing charging policy retained.

charging_orders.reason: Standing order for routine validated fission-grid charging of configured excavators when a battery cannot support its next work interval. Batteries are currently full and grid is uncommissioned, so each execution must still validate commissioned power, availability and limits.
charging_orders.rule: Charge when stored energy cannot supply one source-rated work interval; respect all existing grid/equipment validators

limits: Readiness and post-readiness acceptance failed/not established; water stayed held by actual agents.
Eight-step controlled cases do not establish full fault recovery, long-run reliability or superiority.
Default mission has no validated manipulator, service/spare/offload manifest or full thermal calibration.
Source pins are frozen; these experiments do not create local instrument readings.
Final API record projection was optimized after generation; provider verification establishes the executed planner/engine revision, not every later API change.
